effectiveElements.primary: stable canonical unique elements from mainchain uses role=primary
effectiveElements.secondary: stable canonical unique elements from mainchain uses role=secondary, excluding primary duplicates
effectiveElements.avoid: stable canonical unique elements from mainchain uses role=avoid

auxiliaryBoundary: Seasonal conflict/pending remains explicitly recorded; application selects only the resolved project mainchain uses. Do not silently merge seasonal targets. certificateRequiredFields.profileId: Validated profile identity; not a sole validation key
certificateRequiredFields.birthFacts: original solar/lunar record, leap flag, recorded time, timezone, timeBasis/longitude plus exact current-calendar known pillars and actual instant; no parent names/notes needed
certificateRequiredFields.calendarIdentity: baseline Bazi version, time-basis version/method/source, fixed four-pillar and birth-facts binding digest
certificateRequiredFields.resourceIdentity: exact1.3.1 rules/source-lock/publication and pinned fixed kernel resource identities; no untrusted runtime caller pins; never relabel1.3.0 bytes
certificateRequiredFields.rootSummary: scope/resolution, all regime IDs+consistency, consistentIds/possibleIds, selected regime ID, complete root assumptions/capacities and witness intervals/qualification summaries
certificateRequiredFields.controlSummary: closed status, iteration/residual/error-bound/roundoff and pinned coefficient-validation summary sufficient to bind the selected actual certificate
certificateRequiredFields.mainchainOpinion: decisionStatus/numeric status, strength/branch, exact uses primary/secondary/avoid and referenced rule/carrier IDs, empty relevant missing, entry-policy context
certificateRequiredFields.auxiliary: seasonal status/candidates/conflicts and limitations, explicitly outside adopted elements
certificateRequiredFields.engineResultDigest: digest of canonical full raw engine result from the same run, not DTO.detail or client input
certificateRequiredFields.digest: digest of canonical certificate excluding this digest field

verification.required: Rebuild using saved validated birth facts, exact saved base calendar/Bazi version, exact saved method/entry policy and retained resource version; recompute full engine result, gate and compact canonical certificate; compare every field plus both digests. Historical verification must not call a facade that silently selects the current calendar version.
verification.storage: Persist compact typed certificate only; full diagnostic trace can be recomputed by the same pinned saved version for inspection
verification.missingFrozenResources: Reject unsupported saved project record; never use latest1.3-compatible code or1.1 as substitute
